# hop — your personal travel agent

> https://hop.flights

hop compares your points to live cash fares using published saver charts. It calculates cents per point and tells you when points beat cash — and when to pay.

## What hop does

- Searches cash fares and published award charts for the same trip
- Computes cents per point (cpp) for every award option
- Ranks redemptions by value and tells you which one wins
- Tracks your real loyalty balances across programs
- Alerts you when the math changes on routes you care about

## The verdict engine

hop's engine computes — it never generates. Every economic number (cpp, miles, price, verdict) comes from deterministic code, not an LLM. The engine:

1. Fans out to upstream cash and award sources concurrently
2. Computes per-option economics (cpp = (cash − taxes) × 100 / miles)
3. Ranks by cpp, applies user preferences, picks the winner
4. Renders a verdict: use points, transfer first, or pay cash

cpp tiers: ≥3.0¢/pt is good (green), ≥1.5¢/pt is acceptable (amber), below is weak.

## MCP server

hop exposes its verdict engine as an MCP server at https://hop.flights/api/mcp

Tools available:
- price_trip — price one destination with verdict
- verdict — full points-vs-cash call for a route
- sweet_spots — top-value award redemptions ranked by cpp
- transfer_paths — transfer reachability for a program
- compare_programs — loyalty programs head-to-head on a route
- best_card_for_program — top points-earning card for a program

Works without auth (pass balances directly) or with a hop token for personalized results.

## Key surfaces

- /search — the flight search with live verdict
- /deals — high-value redemptions worth your miles right now
- /sweet-spots — best uses of miles by program
- /destinations — destination guides with points-vs-cash context
- /ask — AI concierge grounded in your real points
- /pricing — search is free; Pro ($49/yr) is the watchlist
